column1: # Every run id named in a verdict or a plan resolves here, so a published claim
# can be traced back to the run that produced it. Column one is the id, column
# two is the document that cites it. `scripts/check-analysis-record.sh` enforces
# this: a verdict that names a run id with no index entry fails CI.
# Ids below were added when that check was introduced. They were already cited
# by the named documents; only the index entry was missing, which is why the
# citing document is recorded rather than a purpose.
# Earlier runs are indexed in the per-arm files that carry the arm name
